acceptanceTests: home and caravan show the same canonical mission
home mode identifies Meta Quest Air Link as the normal transport
Air Link disconnect loses no canonical state or evidence
Quest disconnect loses no state or evidence
Starlink interruption causes the expected degraded posture
stale state cannot authorize remote action
control remains useful without media streaming

implementationGate: Use Meta Quest Air Link as Stephan's normal home transport profile. Prioritise a locally rendered Quest command surface for caravan use. Treat remote PCVR streaming as optional and do not begin execution-capable spatial integration until the parent doctrine readiness gates are proven.
